p.s: Nowadays, anybody can tavel anywhere and I think that choosing to travel with a group is a personal chose and it also depends on where you 're traveling and what you want to do while your traveling.
If you are planing to travel to Europe, I think that going with a group led by a tour guide is a good chose.
The main reason that people travel to Europe is to visit and to learn about all off those towns, musems, castles, bridges and monuments.
The tour guide will probably satisfy your willings conserning those kind of subjects, that 's his job.
Using a tour guide is when your taveling to visit.
You can also choose to travel with your family or wife just to relax, get away from town and have a good time.
For that kind of situation, you do n't need a tour guide.
You take your vacation in nice resorts to relax, to lay down on your back on the beach.
What 's the use for a tour guide if you plan to go on a trip under the sun to just have fun and to chill at the pool with a drink in your hand.
Also tour guides can cost a lot, you 're already paying a lot of money to travel, why pay more fore a tour guide.
I think the chose to travel with a group and a tour guide will always depend on where you are going and what you want to do in your vacations.
What 's the fun of getting in a groupe with a buch of people that you do n't know and not have all the right of going where you want and do what you want.
Traveling is to have fun and for me, somebody that tells you what to do, at what time to get up and that decides for you where to go is not having fun.
Choosing the way you want to travel is personal and choosing whit who and whit a tour guide is also a personal chose.
It 's for those reason that I disagree with the statement.
